# Armith

> Identity verification (KYC) API: ID document reading, selfie face match, liveness, video identification, NFC chip verification checked on the server, webhooks, multi-tenant. Country independent (Türkiye, Germany, UK, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Poland). Self-hostable.

Base docs: https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com
OpenAPI: https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/openapi.yaml

## Start here
- [Quickstart](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/quickstart): first verification in minutes
- [How it works](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/concepts/how-it-works)
- [Authentication](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/reference/authentication): API keys, session tokens
- [Sandbox testing](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/reference/sandbox-testing): deterministic scenarios

## Advanced
- [Countries](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/countries): supported countries and how to add one
- [Video Ident](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/video-ident): human, AI or AI-then-human, regulatory floors, AI disclosure
- [eID NFC](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/eid-nfc): server-side chip verification (passive authentication, CRLs, master lists)
- [Sovereign mode](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/sovereign-mode): no third-party AI
- [Policy rules](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/policy-rules): readable conditions that hold or reject cases; rules only tighten, never approve
- [Web SDK](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/guides/hosted-capture/web-sdk): popup/redirect helper for hosted capture
- [Audit and four-eyes](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/audit-and-review): tamper-evident audit trail, per-case audit pack, second-reviewer approval
- [Security and compliance](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/security-and-compliance)
- [Data rights (GDPR)](https://armith-docs-standalone.onrender.com/advanced/data-subject-rights)

## Rules an agent integrating Armith should follow
- Never trust client-asserted chip flags: send raw chip files to `/kyc/eid-check`; the server decides.
- The AI never decides a verification; a human reviewer or deterministic rules do.
- Use an `Idempotency-Key` on verification POSTs.
- Never log API keys or applicant data.
